resolved_findings.finding: Failed or malformed comments responses were rendered as an empty conversation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Render localized failure with Retry and no raw backend detail; empty is used only for a valid empty array.

resolved_findings.finding: Reply mode had no local cancellation path and could leave the next comment bound to a parent.
resolved_findings.resolution: A localized cancel control clears parent_id, restores the normal placeholder and remains reusable.

resolved_findings.finding: The viewer ellipsis advertised more options but invoked Report directly.
resolved_findings.resolution: It now opens a colocated internal menu with Not interested and Report and deterministic close paths.

resolved_findings.finding: Comment mutations leaked backend strings or failed silently.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reaction, edit, withdraw and create use stable localized error and success messages.

resolved_findings.finding: Full-screen controls and comment threads mixed Romanian literals into EN, PL and AR.
resolved_findings.resolution: Viewer and comment conversation copy is catalogued across all four supported locales with bidi isolation.

resolved_findings.finding: Dynamic viewer aria-label markup broke the modal accessible-name audit.
resolved_findings.resolution: The dialog now references a stable localized hidden label through aria-labelledby.

capacity.observed_evidence: Capacity indicator is not programmatically observable in this run; the separate worker remains usage-limited.
